run_bco_training: run BCO training on a causal language model using the ultrafeedback dataset with full training
run_bco_qlora: run BCO training with QLoRA on a causal language model using 4-bit quantization and PEFT
embed_prompt: embed prompt input tokens using mean pooling, normalization, and layer normalization from nomic embed model
train_bco_model: train a model with BCOTrainer using embedding function, reference model, and tokenizer for preference alignment
save_bco_model: save a trained BCO-aligned model to an output directory and optionally push to the Hugging Face Hub
